name: section-sidebar-shell
title: Section sidebar shell
description: Two-tier navigation: the sections of a product along the top, and a sidebar that lists the pages of the current section only. Sheet and scrolling tabs on phones.
docs: Pass sections ({ id, label, href }), the id of the active one, sidebars (the pages of each section in the SidebarNav shape, by section id) and currentHref; the current section is underlined with aria-current, the current page is marked in the sidebar. Pass your router's Link as linkAs: both the sections and the pages use it, so switching section is a normal navigation and focus stays on the link you used. A section without an entry in sidebars has no sidebar. brand and account fill the header; sidebarFooter sits under the sidebar and in the sheet. Below md the sidebar is a left sheet opened from a menu button (focus returns to it, following a link closes it) and the sections scroll sideways under the brand with faded edges. The header never moves and the page scrolls inside the shell, which is as tall as its container: it is h-dvh unless you pass a height in className. menuLabel, sectionsLabel, pagesLabel and skipLabel translate the words. Pass mainId when the page already uses id=main.
